name: AnimeSchedule Sync
description: Personal, shared server, or disabled anime sync per Jellyfin user; protected connection management and safe legacy migration.

versions.changelog: Private settings sessions expire after five idle minutes or thirty minutes total. Refreshed plugin pages and disconnect confirmations.
Fix regular-user access: standalone account page with Jellyfin sign-in, shareable settings link and OAuth return link.
Multi-user Personal / Server / None modes, permission controls, safe migration and isolated retries. Catalogue-ready packaging.
